title: Bound the product Kura-space ownership test fixture
description: The Windows test fixture created a kura-spaces directory without its required beads directory and without a repository boundary. Ownership discovery therefore climbed into the user profile and attempted to enumerate WSL's ext4.vhdx.
acceptanceCriteria: The fixture contains both the required beads directory and a local .git boundary; focused ownership discovery never traverses outside the fixture and passes on Windows.
